features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 8 Epson i3200-A1 Printheads
items.desc: Eight industrial Epson i3200-A1 heads deliver precision sublimation output at up to 360 x 1200 dpi, combining high-speed 1-pass production with sharp detail and vibrant colour reproduction across the full 1900 mm print width.

items.title: Auto Fabric Tension Control
items.desc: Automatic tension management continuously adjusts media tightness throughout the run, preventing wrinkles and registration errors on both paper and direct fabric substrates.

items.title: Jumbo Roll Compatibility
items.desc: Supports media rolls up to 1,000 metres, allowing extended uninterrupted production runs without frequent roll changes and the associated downtime on high-volume order batches.

items.title: Dual Infrared Drying Units
items.desc: Two infrared drying units work in sequence to maximise drying efficiency at high print speeds, ensuring fully set ink before collection and reducing smudging on continuous production runs.

items.title: Stable 5-Litre Bulk Ink System
items.desc: Bulk ink supply provides consistent, stable ink pressure to all 8 heads simultaneously, reducing manual refill frequency and maintaining uninterrupted ink flow during long production shifts.

items.title: Double High-Precision Mute Rail
items.desc: Dual precision mute rail system minimises carriage vibration and operational noise, improving both print sharpness and working conditions during sustained high-speed production.

items.title: Rear Media Balance Bar
items.desc: Integrated balance bar at the rear of the machine maintains even tension across the full media width during feeding, ensuring accurate, distortion-free output throughout long production runs.

items.title: Extra Intelligent Dryer Device
items.desc: Smart heat control system monitors and adjusts dryer temperature in real time, optimising ink fixation at every print speed and reducing smudging or under-drying defects across all production modes.

items.title: Direct Drive Linear Motor System
items.desc: A mute linear motor system that eliminates the need for belts and PVC encoder strips, improving carriage moving precision and increasing the machine's lifespan.

items.title: Vacuum Ink with On-Line Filter
items.desc: Filters out air and ink impurities to ensure impurity-free printing and high production efficiency.

items.title: Negative Pressure Ink Supply System
items.desc: Optimizes ink flow to minimize the risk of running out of ink during critical, long-run print jobs.

items.title: Lack-of-Media Sensor
items.desc: A simple and clear indicator system that flags the absence of media.

items.title: Inflatable Take-up and Feed Media Shaft
items.desc: Offers a highly efficient way to manage heavy fabric rolls.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: High-Volume Sublimation Transfer Paper Production
fabrics.desc: Fast, consistent sublimation printing on transfer paper for manufacturers supplying large volumes of printed paper to heat press operations across polyester garment and fabric production.

fabrics.title: Polyester Fashion Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: Direct sublimation output on polyester sarees, dress materials, sportswear fabrics, and fashion textiles for wholesale and export markets requiring vibrant, wash-fast colour at production volume.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Activewear Production
fabrics.desc: High-resolution sublimation on polyester performance fabrics for sportswear brands, gym wear manufacturers, and activewear exporters needing sharp detail and consistent colour across large orders.

fabrics.title: Home Textile Sublimation Production
fabrics.desc: Sublimation printing on polyester curtains, cushion covers, upholstery fabrics, and decorative soft furnishings for domestic retail and export home textile markets.

fabrics.title: Job Work and Multi-Buyer Sublimation Operations
fabrics.desc: High daily output across 1-pass and 2-pass modes makes the Alpha II well suited to job work printers managing multiple buyers with varying order sizes and design complexities.

fabrics.title: Custom and Short-Run Polyester Printing
fabrics.desc: Fast setup and consistent output make the Alpha II a practical choice for custom polyester printing, sampling, and shorter-run specialty orders for fashion designers and brand merchandising.
